# Dormer

> Dormer is a macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a live island: music player with Shazam, listening together with nearby Macs, AirDrop shelf, clipboard history, per-app volume, ChatGPT and Claude, alerts, and a pixel companion that lives in the notch. Free for the core features; Dormer Pro is a one-time purchase (€10.99, 14-day free trial, no subscription). Made by an independent developer in France.

Dormer needs a Mac with a notch and macOS 14.2 or later. It is downloaded from GitHub or with Homebrew (`brew install --cask zerdoxy741/dormer/dormer`). It is signed but not notarized by Apple, so macOS shows a warning on first launch; the versions page explains how to check the download.
